name: named-constants
title: Design-token card
summary: A card whose corner radius, spacing, chip size and four colours all come from named tokens in resources.variables and resources.colors, referenced as @name and @colors.name.
prompt: Build a card whose spacing, corner radius and colours come from named design tokens instead of hard-coded numbers.
teaches: Declare numeric tokens in resources.variables and colour tokens in resources.colors
Reference a number token as @gap, or inside an expression such as "@gap * 4 + @chip"
Reference a colour token in a paint op as @colors.accent

Fit a drawing authored at the header size to any box: a variable s = min(componentWidth() / W, componentHeight() / H), a translate by half the extra space and a scale by s about the design's centre; the background drawRect runs before it, to componentWidth() × componentHeight()
pitfalls: resources.colors are exported (named, host-visible) by default, resources.variables are not: add "export": true to a variable only when the host should be able to change it
A token used in arithmetic must be written inside the expression string ("@gap * 3"), and each distinct expression becomes its own float op; reuse the same expression text rather than near-duplicates
A token is a host variable only when it is exported ({"value": 16, "export": true}); a plain number in resources.variables is a private constant the host can't see or change

Canvas coordinates are pixels of the box the host gives the document, not of the header: a background drawRect to the literal header size leaves the rest of a bigger box unpainted, and literal positions get cut off in a smaller one

snippets.note: radius, gap and chip sizes plus four named colours

check.describe: A dark rounded card inset 12 dp with a title and three blue rounded chips spaced 12 dp apart; the four colours are listed as named colours. Resized, the background fills the box and the drawing scales uniformly to fit, centred.
